description: This file provides a service for resolving project names from project IDs using cross-collection lookups with caching, supporting multiple data sources such as AppDeployments, Projects, SessionTracking, Costs, Tenants, and Users.

methods.name: getCached
methods.description: Retrieve a project name from cache if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: setCached
methods.description: Store a project name in cache with a specified TTL.

methods.name: buildProjectIdOrQuery
methods.description: Construct a case-insensitive query to match project ID across multiple possible fields.

methods.name: pickNameFromDeployment
methods.description: Select the project name from a deployment document based on precedence.

methods.name: pickNameFromProject
methods.description: Select the project name from a project document.

methods.name: pickNameFromSession
methods.description: Select the project name from a session tracking document.

methods.name: pickNameFromCost
methods.description: Select the project name from a cost document.

methods.name: pickNameFromTenant
methods.description: Select the project name from a tenant document.

methods.name: pickNameFromUser
methods.description: Select the project name from a user document.

methods.name: lookupProjectName
methods.description: Attempt to find the project name by querying multiple collections in order.

methods.name: resolveProjectName
methods.description: Public function to resolve a project name from a project ID with caching.

methods.name: resolveProjectNames
methods.description: Bulk resolve multiple project IDs to project names, utilizing cache and sequential lookup.
